opportunities.name: Medical bag AD conversion
opportunities.objective: Test medical bag ad conversion against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Blunt Force Trauma passively grants 2-3.2% source health as AD; Bloodmail adds a separate bonus-health conversion and Titanic adds attack pressure. Maximum Dosage increases max health and regeneration, making timed E attacks the payoff rather than pretending bonesaws scale with AD.
opportunities.requiredState: Earn realistic Heartsteel stacks and use R before the finishing E trade.
opportunities.failure: Healing reduction and percent-health damage punish the huge health pool.
opportunities.test: Record E attack damage before and during R at equal missing-health percentages.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Health conversions are additive hypotheses, not recursive infinite AD.

opportunities.name: Bonesaw resistance execution
opportunities.objective: Test bonesaw resistance execution against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Infected Bonesaw removes 20-30% current health as magic damage without an AP ratio; Blade supplies an independent physical current-health attack. Trinity follows cleaver casts with physical Spellblade while resistances let Mundo remain for W's gray-health detonation.
opportunities.requiredState: Land Q first and detonate W on a champion after absorbing damage.
opportunities.failure: Bonesaw weakens as health drops and lack of mobility loses attacks.
opportunities.test: Compare Q then three attacks against different health and resistance targets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP purchases do not improve the documented bonesaw percentage; W needs a champion hit for full gray healing.

ruledOut.reason: Health conversions are additive hypotheses, not recursive infinite AD.

unknowns: Item and ability proc attribution requires a controlled current-patch test; symbolic statFormula and source flags are not runtime verification.

builds.name: Medical bag AD conversion
builds.summary: Test medical bag ad conversion against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test medical bag ad conversion against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Blunt Force Trauma passively grants 2-3.2% source health as AD; Bloodmail adds a separate bonus-health conversion and Titanic adds attack pressure. Maximum Dosage increases max health and regeneration, making timed E attacks the payoff rather than pretending bonesaws scale with AD.
testPlan: Required state: Earn realistic Heartsteel stacks and use R before the finishing E trade.
Record E attack damage before and during R at equal missing-health percentages.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Healing reduction and percent-health damage punish the huge health pool.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Health conversions are additive hypotheses, not recursive infinite AD.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Heartsteel, Overlord's Bloodmail, Titanic Hydra, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Dr. Mundo hurls his bonesaw, dealing [(0.2 / 0.225 / 0.25 / 0.275 / 0.3) × 100]% current Health magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slowing them by [40]% for [2] seconds.

If the bonesaw hits a champion or monster, Dr. Mundo restores [(1) × (50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90)] Health. If it hits a non-champion or non-monster, Dr. Mundo instead restores [(0.5) × (50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90)] Health.
